Strong corporate earnings and the AI buildout reinforce our pro-risk stance.We stay overweight U.S. and emerging market equities on the ongoing AI theme, and we like thematic opportunities across infrastructure, defense and energy. U.S. earnings momentum is gathering steam as [mega forces](https://www.blackrock.com/corporate/insights/blackrock-investment-institute/publications/mega-forces/geopolitical-fragmentation) – big structural changes such as geopolitical fragmentation and AI – are increasingly driving investment outcomes. Another key reason for U.S. equity fortitude: [The AI mega force is strengthening](https://www.blackrock.com/corporate/literature/market-commentary/weekly-investment-commentary-en-us-20260420-a-supercharged-ai-mega-force.pdf). We favor [thematic opportunities](https://www.blackrock.com/corporate/literature/market-commentary/weekly-investment-commentary-en-us-20260330-mideast-shock-fuels-investing-themes.pdf) amid a fragmenting world in search of energy security: infrastructure and defense in Europe and beyond. Read our past weekly market commentaries [here](https://www.blackrock.com/corporate/insights/blackrock-investment-institute/archives "Read our past weekly market commentaries.").
